== Summary ==
[[Barry Alperstein]] (4th place) with his crystal award. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Identified, though he wears a face mask, by matching his hair (side-swept dark hair, forehead), ears, eyes and beard to his place in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] (standing, plaid shirt; wrap-up caption); best judgement, supported by elimination: the other five award photos show other Top 8 players, and neither Joe Olson nor Matt Scott matches.

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
